headline: A 2008 executive order on how federal agencies handle orders of succession, meaning who takes charge when a leader cannot serve.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with the duties of executive branch agencies regarding orders of succession. These are the rules that say who takes over an agency's top job if the leader dies, resigns, or is unable to serve. No summary was provided, so the specific requirements are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and their senior officials
who_it_affects.how: The order likely sets out what agencies must do about naming or keeping track of who steps in when a top official cannot serve.
